product.title: Experience Two Night Ranch Adventure

description.text: A two-night package at Grand Canyon Western Ranch pairs western lodging with guided horseback rides and wagon tours across open range. Evenings bring live music and ranch-style dining while days leave room to visit the South Rim on your own or with optional tours.

highlights: Two-night western ranch stay near the Grand Canyon
Guided horseback and wagon ride activities included
Ranch meals and live evening entertainment
Family-friendly lodging on the Hualapai Reservation
Flexible time for South Rim sightseeing

start.description: Arrive at Grand Canyon Western Ranch, 3750 E Diamond Bar Rd, Peach Springs, AZ 86434 for afternoon check-in.

end.description: Depart from Grand Canyon Western Ranch after breakfast on departure day.
